events.title: OB/GYN annual visit — routine GYN exam
events.summary: Routine annual gynecologic visit with Dr. Karen Wu. Breast and pelvic exams were unremarkable. Patient reported no breast complaints, and is peri-menopausal with mild, non-bothersome hot flashes.

source.snippet: Annual GYN visit. Pt c/o no breast complaints. Breast exam: no masses palpated bilaterally. Plan: routine screening mammogram.

events.title: Pap + HPV co-test performed
events.summary: Cervical cancer screening Pap smear and HPV co-test were performed today. Results expected within 7 days.

source.snippet: Pap + HPV co-test performed today. Last normal co-test 02/15/2023. Will report results within 7 days.

events.title: Referral to imaging — screening mammogram
events.summary: Referred to Breast Imaging Center for a routine screening mammogram, due based on the 24-month interval since the last one in February 2022.

source.snippet:
Refer to Breast Imaging Center for screening mammogram.
Last screening mammogram was 04-Feb-2022 (over the 24-month interval, due now).

events.title: Mammogram — BI-RADS 4 (suspicious)
events.summary: Screening mammogram with digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) found a new 1.2 cm spiculated mass in the right breast at the 11 o'clock position, 3 cm from the nipple. Rated BI-RADS 4 (Suspicious abnormality) — a category indicating biopsy is recommended. The left breast was normal (BI-RADS 1).

source.snippet: FINDINGS: 1.2 cm spiculated mass identified in right breast at the 11 o'clock position, approx 3 cm from nipple. ASSESSMENT: BI-RADS 4 — Suspicious abnormality. Biopsy recommended.

events.title: Referral to Breast Surgery (Dr. Patel, UCSF)
events.summary: Dr. Karen Wu referred Maria to Dr. Anil Patel, Breast Surgery at UCSF, for evaluation of a suspicious right breast mass and ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy, following a BI-RADS 4 mammogram result.

source.snippet: Refer to Dr. Patel, Breast Surgery, for evaluation of suspicious mass r/o malignancy.

events.title: Breast surgery consult
events.summary: New consultation with Dr. Anil Patel (breast surgery) for evaluation of a suspicious right breast mammogram finding. Physical exam showed no palpable mass; Dr. Patel personally reviewed the prior mammogram and confirmed a 1.2 cm spiculated mass at the 11 o'clock position.

source.snippet: Pt seen in consultation for s/p suspicious mammogram. Reviewed images. Plan: schedule core needle biopsy for next week.

events.title: Core needle biopsy — benign (fibroadenoma)
events.summary: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy of the right breast mass at the 11 o'clock position returned a benign result — fibroadenoma. No evidence of malignancy, atypia, or carcinoma was found.

source.snippet: Pathology: Right breast mass, ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy. DIAGNOSIS: Fibroadenoma, no evidence of malignancy.

events.title: OB/GYN follow-up — post-biopsy debrief
events.summary: Follow-up visit with Dr. Wu to discuss the benign breast biopsy result. Biopsy site was well-healed on exam, no new masses found. Routine annual screening mammogram will resume on schedule.

source.snippet: Pt returns to discuss benign biopsy result. Reassured. Will resume routine annual screening mammogram.
